name: Pull-up
steps: Grip the bar overhand slightly wider than shoulder width.
Hang with a braced trunk and controlled shoulders.
Drive elbows down to lift until the chin clears the bar without craning the neck.
Lower under control to straight arms.
cues: Let the shoulder blades rotate as the arms move.
mistakes: Kicking or swinging to finish the rep.
Reaching with the chin while the body stays low.
breathing: Exhale as you pull up; inhale as you lower.
